question: The fungus Puccinia graminis causes:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Black rust in wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The fungus *Puccinia graminis tritici* **causes the **black rust of wheat**.
 
• The **disease **is also known as **stem rust of wheat**.
 
• It **affects **the **grains**, **stems**, and **leaves **of the **plant**.
 
• **Heteroecious* Puccinia graminis tritici****.*
 
• The **parasite needs **two partners in order to **complicate its life **because it **belongs to the heteroecious family**.
 
• **Wheat **and **Kentucky blue grass stem rust **are caused by* **Puccinia garminis**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Red rot**, **prevalent in South Asia and Indonesia**, is distinguished by **sporadic red** and **white patches **inside the **cane **and **a sour alcoholic odor **when the **rod is split open**.
 
• Late blight, is the **most significant potato disease**, which is brought on **by the fungus Phytophthora infestans** and can quickly **lead to crop failures **if proper control measures are not taken.
 
• A **ring-shaped rash that is itchy**, **scaly**, and **slightly elevated is frequently caused by ringworm**. Typically, the rings begin small and then spread outward. A rash known as ringworm of the body (*tinea corporis*) is brought on by a fungus. The rash is typically round and irritating, with clearer skin in the center.
